title: JmapUri: exactly one object-id per object-uri-00
description:
SCOPE REPLACED 2026-10-20: do NOT switch to urn:jmap:. Keep the jmap: scheme per draft-atwood-jmap-object-uri-00.

Oracle: jmap-chat-spec 6bcd9d8 (quoted text). Mapped by wf_6712c4f8-c2b.

[chat-core] JmapUri: accept exactly one object-id (drop tasks multi-segment form)
Spec (42c244b): draft-atwood-jmap-object-uri-00.md L71-77: "jmap-object-uri = \"jmap:\" type-name \":\" account-id \":\" object-id / type-name = 1*( %x61-7A / DIGIT ) / account-id = 1*255id-char / object-id = 1*255id-char"; L96: "A receiver treats a `jmap` URI that matches no form it implements as unresolvable."; draft-atwood-jmap-chat-tasks-00.md L191: "in the form `jmap:task:<accountId>:<taskId>`"
Code: crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:36-40 (object_ids: Vec<Id>); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:81-113 (new() takes Vec, accepts 1..n ids); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:125-136 (object_id() = last; object_ids()); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:166-170 (FromStr collects all trailing segments); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:174-178 (Display writes every segment); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/tasks.rs:16-17,34-36,74-89 (JmapUri::task_ids returns (taskListId, taskId) from 5-segment form); crate-jmap-chat-types/tests/jmap_uri.rs:36-45,52,110 (task multi-segment fixtures); crate-jmap-chat-types/tests/chat_tasks.rs:228-250; crate-jmap-chat-federation-server/tests/outbound.rs:263 (uri "urn:jmap:task:A1:T1", old URN form); CHANGELOG.md:685
Now: Parses and renders jmap:<type>:<acct>:<id>[:<id>...]; "jmap:task:A1:TL1:T9" parses successfully and task_ids() yields a taskListId, a form that matches no jmap-object-uri production. Scheme, type grammar, Id charset/length (crate-jmap-types/src/id.rs:191-211) and case-insensitive scheme (jmap_uri.rs:158) already conform.
Change: Make object_id a single Id: new(data_type, account_id, object_id); FromStr rejects any segment after the object-id (new error variant or reuse InvalidObjectId); remove object_ids() and task_ids() (callers use data_type()==JMAP_URI_TASK_TYPE + object_id()). Re-cite module/type docs to draft-atwood-jmap-object-uri-00 §JMAP Object URIs instead of the "private-use" calendars-draft scheme (jmap_uri.rs:1-13,19). Update the test fixtures to the new drafts as oracle; change outbound.rs:263 fixture to jmap:task:A1:T1 or an https URI. Public API break; CHANGELOG.

[chat-ext] JmapUri must use one object id; drop the 5-segment task form
Spec (42c244b): draft-atwood-jmap-object-uri-00.md L71-77: "jmap-object-uri = \"jmap:\" type-name \":\" account-id \":\" object-id" ... "object-id = 1*255id-char"; draft-atwood-jmap-chat-tasks-00.md L191: "A JMAP object URI ({{JMAP-OBJECT-URI}}) of type `task`, in the form `jmap:task:<accountId>:<taskId>`, referencing a Task on the named account."
Code: crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:1-13 (module doc: private-use scheme, tasks extra segment); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:36-40 object_ids: Vec<Id>; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:84-113 new(.., Vec<Id>); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:132-136 object_ids(); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/jmap_uri.rs:166-170 FromStr accepts any number of trailing segments; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/tasks.rs:16-17,74-89 JmapUri::task_ids; crate-jmap-chat-types/tests/jmap_uri.rs:36-52,106-115; tests/chat_tasks.rs:228-250
Now: The parser accepts jmap:<type>:<acct>:<id>[:<id>...] and renders the multi-segment form; task_ids() reads (taskListId, taskId) from jmap:task:A:TL:T. That form is not a valid jmap-object-uri, and a spec-form jmap:task:A:T yields task_ids() == None. The `jmap` scheme itself is correct (42c244b reverted the urn:jmap: move).
Change: Keep the scheme `jmap` (case-insensitive). Require exactly one object-id (reject extra segments), collapse object_ids to object_id, and change new() to take a single Id. Remove task_ids() and the extra-segment docs; consumers use data_type()=="task" plus object_id(). Update the module doc to cite draft-atwood-jmap-object-uri-00. Update the tests to the new draft text. Restricting to registered types (calendar, calendarevent, principal, task, tasklist, filenode) is optional hardening, because the spec says an unknown form is just unresolvable.

Mark 2026-10-20 DECISION: type-name validation is grammar only (lowercase alnum per ABNF); no registered-name allow-list.
Mark 2026-10-20: graph work goes in now; as part of this bead MOVE JmapUri (and its parse error type) from jmap-chat-types into jmap-types (foundation crate) so graph-projection, chat, calendars, tasks share it; update all importers, no re-export shim (clean break, CHANGELOG BREAKING). Task-specific helpers stay in chat-types.
